subject: english
title: Intermediate Examination 2024 English (Set E) - Section A

questions.question: Raju has helped Usha. (Choose the correct passive voice)
options: Usha has been helped by Raju.
Usha has been helping by Raju.
questions.explanation: Present perfect active ('has helped') becomes present perfect passive ('has been helped by Raju.').

questions.question: The college foundation day was cancelled as ________ political workers tried to forcibly enter the campus. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Some' is used before plural countable nouns ('political workers') to indicate an unspecified number.

questions.question: Ranjan was accused ________ theft. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Accused of' is the standard preposition used with 'accused'.

questions.question: The bride and the bridegroom ________ wearing similar colour outfits. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: Compound plural subject ('The bride and the bridegroom') takes plural 'were' before 'wearing'.

questions.question: The builder finished the work in one week. (Choose the correct negative sentence)
options: The builder had not finished the work in one week.
The builder did not finished the work in one week.
The builder did not finish the work in one week.
The builder was not finish the work in one week.
questions.explanation: Simple past negative uses 'did not + base verb (finish)'.

questions.question: Rohan said to him, "Go away." (Choose the correct indirect narration)
options: Rohan orders him to go away.
Rohan ordered him to go away.
Rohan will order him to go away.
Rohan had ordered him to go away.
questions.explanation: Past reporting verb 'said to' with a command becomes 'ordered him to go away'.

questions.question: I can help you ________ you stick to your words. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: Conditional conjunction 'if' introduces the condition for help.

questions.question: Radha is very ________. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Talkative' is the standard adjective describing someone who talks a lot.

questions.question: Choose the odd one out:
questions.explanation: 'Shoes' are footwear, whereas jacket, shirt, and coat are upper-body garments.

questions.question: Jitendra works at the new office building, ________? (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: Positive simple present statement with singular 'Jitendra' takes negative tag 'doesn't he'.

questions.question: Choose the correct meaning of "At the eleventh hour":
questions.explanation: 'At the eleventh hour' means at the very last possible moment.

questions.question: Sunita declared that she was ________ last night. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Was robbed' is the passive past form indicating she was a victim of robbery.

questions.question: He ________ robbed as he was walking out of the bank. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Got robbed' expresses something unfortunate happening to the subject.

questions.question: The fireman ________ the fire. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Put out' means to extinguish a fire.

questions.question: Choose the correct spelling:
questions.explanation: 'Popularity' is the correct spelling.

questions.question: She said to Moti, "Don't move." (Choose the correct indirect speech)
options: She told Moti not to move.
No move is what she told Moti.
Moti says that she tells him not to move.
Moti had said that she told him to move not.
questions.explanation: Negative imperative 'Don't move' becomes 'not to move' in indirect speech.

questions.question: Sohan's mango is the ________ of all. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: Superlative degree 'the sweetest' is used when comparing one item against all others.

questions.question: The students have gone to ________ school. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: No article is needed before 'school' when referring to its primary purpose for students.

questions.question: Kamesh is afraid ________ crocodiles. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Afraid of' is the standard preposition used with 'afraid'.

questions.question: Criminals ________ no sympathy for innocent people. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: Plural subject 'Criminals' takes plural verb 'have'.

questions.question: The letter was written by her. (Choose the correct active voice)
questions.explanation: Simple past passive ('was written by her') converts to simple past active ('She wrote the letter.').

questions.question: Gajendra's father asked ________ to repay the loan in time. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: Object pronoun 'him' is required after the verb 'asked'.

questions.question: You ________ cross the road when the traffic light is red. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Mustn't' expresses strong prohibition against crossing on a red light.

questions.question: Whenever ________ in a difficult situation, do let me know. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'You're' (you are) fits before the prepositional phrase 'in a difficult situation'.

questions.question: I have to buy an ________ of Lord Ganesha. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Idol' means a statue or image of a deity.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence:
questions.explanation: 'Confident of + gerund' ('confident of winning') is the grammatically standard structure.

questions.question: You ________ tell my mother about my result. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Mustn't' conveys strong prohibition.

questions.question: The man came ________ me. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Came to me' indicates direction/approach toward the speaker.

questions.question: My grandmother told me a ________. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Tale' means a story, matching the singular article 'a'.

questions.question: We are ________ next week. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: Present continuous ('are moving') is commonly used for planned future arrangements.

questions.question: Try to come ________ hour before the class starts. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Hour' begins with a vowel sound (/aʊər/), so 'an' is used.

questions.question: I ________ Mr. Singh at nine p.m. last night. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Last night' indicates simple past tense ('called').

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence:
options: He does dare not go there.
He does not dare go there.
questions.explanation: As a modal auxiliary in negative/interrogative structures, 'dare' stays uninflected ('He dare not go there.').

questions.question: I ________ be happy to meet you. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'I can be happy to meet you.' is grammatically valid among the given choices.

questions.question: They ________ the bridge. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Blew up' means destroyed by explosion, in simple past tense.

questions.question: We don't have ________ fruit juice. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Much' is used with uncountable nouns ('fruit juice') in negative sentences.

questions.question: The government has called ________ the army. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Call out' means to summon or deploy forces/services for an emergency.

questions.question: Choose the correct meaning of: "To hold one's tongue"
questions.explanation: 'To hold one's tongue' means to stay silent or refrain from speaking.

questions.question: Choose the odd one out:
questions.explanation: 'Cloth' is a fabric/material, whereas shirt, frock, and skirt are stitched garments.

questions.question: I have friends ________ love me a lot. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Who' acts as the subject relative pronoun referring to people ('friends').

questions.question: Choose the correct synonym of 'Catch':
questions.explanation: 'Grab' is a synonym of 'catch'.

questions.question: The antonym of 'Arrival' is:
questions.explanation: 'Departure' is the opposite of 'arrival'.

questions.question: Choose the correctly spelt word:
questions.explanation: 'Property' is the correct spelling.

questions.question: There is no ________ rule about good food. (Choose the correct phrase)
questions.explanation: 'Hard and fast rule' is a fixed idiom meaning a strict or unalterable rule.

questions.question: I have waited for ________ hour. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Hour' starts with a vowel sound, so 'an' is used.

questions.question: The baby is still crying, ________? (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: Positive present continuous statement takes negative tag 'isn't he'.

questions.question: Choose the correct antonym of 'Haughty':
questions.explanation: 'Humble' is the antonym of 'haughty' (arrogant).

questions.question: My son is ________ in managing things. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Adept' means skilled or proficient at something.

questions.question: He went there ________ asked for help. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'And' joins two sequential actions ('went there' and 'asked for help').

questions.question: ________ is a good exercise. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: Gerund 'Walking' functions as the subject of the sentence.

questions.question: Please help ________. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: In an imperative addressed to 'you', 'yourself' is the appropriate reflexive pronoun.

questions.question: Sunita is rich enough. She can buy an expensive car. (Choose the correct combination)
options: Sunita is enough rich to buy an expensive car.
Sunita is rich enough to buy an expensive car.
An expensive car can be bought by rich Sunita.
Bought can be an expensive car by rich Sunita.
questions.explanation: 'Enough' follows an adjective ('rich enough') before 'to + infinitive'.

questions.question: He ________ very politely with me. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: Simple past 'dealt' fits naturally as a finite verb in the sentence.

questions.question: There is something wonderful ________ him. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Something wonderful about him' refers to a quality or characteristic of the person.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence:
questions.explanation: 'I need to sleep well.' is grammatically accurate and natural.

questions.question: Please ________ me alone. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Please + base verb (leave)' forms a polite imperative.

questions.question: They ________ have received our letter by now. (Choose the correct answer)
questions.explanation: 'Must have + past participle' expresses strong logical deduction about a completed action.

questions.question: Choose the mis-spelt word:
questions.explanation: 'Goverment' is mis-spelt; the correct spelling is 'Government'.

questions.question: Choose the mis-spelt word:
questions.explanation: The correctly spelt word among the choices is 'Discipline'; 'Discipleen' (along with the other distorted forms) is mis-spelt.

questions.question: A government by one person is ________. (Choose the correct one-word substitution)
questions.explanation: 'Autocracy' is government by a single ruler with absolute power.

questions.question: A ________ woman has to observe some rituals and customs during pregnancy.
questions.explanation: In 'A Child is Born', a pregnant woman observes traditional rituals and customs.

questions.question: ________ loved to polish the gourd in classroom.
questions.explanation: In Shiga Naoya's 'The Artist', young Seibei loved polishing gourds even in class.

questions.question: The redness of the ________ appears cruel to the poet.
questions.explanation: In Keki N. Daruwala's 'Fire-Hymn', the redness of the fire appears cruel.

questions.question: 'However, rare-rare it be; And when I crumble, who will remember' is from:
options: Sweetest Love I Do Not Goe
questions.explanation: These lines are from Walter de la Mare's poem 'An Epitaph'.

questions.question: The freedom of the press usually means freedom from ________ by the government.
questions.explanation: In Dorothy L. Sayers's 'How Free is the Press', press freedom primarily means freedom from government censorship.

questions.question: Pearl S. Buck was invited for ________ by a moderately educated family.
questions.explanation: In 'India Through a Traveller's Eyes', Pearl S. Buck recalls being invited for luncheon.

questions.question: Was it ________ that I dared not kill him? Was it perversity, that I longed to talk to him?
questions.explanation: In D. H. Lawrence's 'Snake', the speaker questions whether cowardice kept him from killing the snake.

questions.question: Autumn is conspiring with the ________ to bless the vine.
questions.explanation: In John Keats's 'Ode to Autumn', autumn conspires with the maturing sun to load and bless the vines.

questions.question: The poet talks about ________ in 'Fire-Hymn'.
questions.explanation: In 'Fire-Hymn', Keki N. Daruwala mentions the Tower of Silence in the context of Parsi funeral customs.

questions.question: 'He sways his head from side to side, with movements like a snake;' is from:
questions.explanation: This line describes Macavity in T. S. Eliot's 'Macavity: The Mystery Cat'.

questions.question: The narrator in 'My Grandmother's House' received ________.
questions.explanation: In Kamala Das's 'My Grandmother's House', the speaker fondly remembers the love she received there.

questions.question: 'Someone was before me at my water-trough,' is from:
questions.explanation: This opening line belongs to D. H. Lawrence's poem 'Snake'.

questions.question: If I should die, think only this of me.' is from:
questions.explanation: This famous line opens Rupert Brooke's poem 'The Soldier'.

questions.question: I despised myself and the voices of my accursed human education.' is from:
questions.explanation: In 'Snake', the poet feels regret and despises his 'accursed human education' after throwing a log at the snake.

questions.question: I harbour for good or bad, I permit to speak at every hazard, ...' Who says this?
questions.explanation: Walt Whitman says this in 'Song of Myself'.

questions.question: .... we saw embers losing their cruel redness' is from:
questions.explanation: This line is from Keki N. Daruwala's 'Fire-Hymn'.

questions.question: The leader should have the basic quality of ________.
questions.explanation: In 'Bharat is My Home', Dr. Zakir Hussain stresses selflessness and dedication to duty for a leader.

questions.question: Benjy's father was a ________.
questions.explanation: In H. E. Bates's 'The Earth', Benjy's father was a simple farmer.

questions.question: ________ discrimination was disapproved by Martin Luther King, Jr.
questions.explanation: In 'I Have a Dream', Martin Luther King, Jr. opposed racial discrimination.

questions.question: ________ was a philosopher and a mathematician.
questions.explanation: Bertrand Russell (author of 'Ideas That Have Helped Mankind') was a renowned philosopher and mathematician.

questions.question: The word 'Renaissance' means:
questions.explanation: 'Renaissance' literally means 'rebirth' or revival of classical learning and art.

questions.question: In the ancient times Latin had the status of a ________ language.
questions.explanation: In ancient/medieval Europe, Latin served as a widely shared scholarly/world language.

questions.question: English is used as a ________ language by the Indians.
questions.explanation: In the Bihar Board curriculum, English is commonly treated as a second language in India.

questions.question: Who wrote 'Emma' and 'Pride and Prejudice'?
questions.explanation: Jane Austen wrote both 'Emma' and 'Pride and Prejudice'.

questions.question: The Old English Period ended in the year:
questions.explanation: The Old English period is marked as ending around AD 1066 with the Norman Conquest.

questions.question: The Norman Conquest made England into little more than a colony of ________.
questions.explanation: The Norman Conquest of 1066 brought French/Norman rule and influence to England.

questions.question: Macavity seems to be half-asleep, but in actuality he is ________.
questions.explanation: In 'Macavity: The Mystery Cat', Macavity appears half-asleep while actually wide awake.

questions.question: According to Gandhi, mind is a ________.
questions.explanation: In 'Indian Civilization and Culture', Mahatma Gandhi compares the mind to a restless bird.

questions.question: Civilization helps in the development of ________.
questions.explanation: True civilization fosters a sense of duty and social responsibility.

questions.question: Which nation has been called the young state of ancient people?
questions.explanation: In 'Bharat is My Home', India is referred to as the young state of an ancient people.

questions.question: Who took a pinch of snuff?
questions.explanation: In Manohar Malgonkar's 'A Pinch of Snuff', Nanukaka regularly took a pinch of snuff.

questions.question: Who wrote 'A Marriage Proposal'?
questions.explanation: 'A Marriage Proposal' is a one-act play by Anton Pavlovich Chekhov.

questions.question: 'And the angel will not come' is from:
options: Now the Leaves are Falling Fast
questions.explanation: This line is from W. H. Auden's 'Now the Leaves are Falling Fast'.

questions.question: The poet in 'The Soldier' is in love with his ________.
questions.explanation: In Rupert Brooke's 'The Soldier', the speaker expresses deep love for his country (England).

questions.question: John Donne was the pioneer of a new kind of lyrical and ________ verse.
questions.explanation: John Donne was a pioneer of a new kind of lyrical and satirical verse.

questions.question: 'Thou watchest the last oozings hours by hours' is from:
questions.explanation: This line appears in John Keats's 'Ode to Autumn' describing the cider-press.

questions.question: Dr. Zakir Hussain delivered the speech on:
options: taking oath as the President of India
taking oath as the Governor of Bihar
questions.explanation: 'Bharat is My Home' is based on Dr. Zakir Hussain's speech upon taking oath as President of India in 1967.

questions.question: Nanukaka stood in the doorway of a ________ class carriage.
questions.explanation: In 'A Pinch of Snuff', Nanukaka stood in the doorway of a second-class carriage.

questions.question: The Negroes were hopeful that one day they would ________.
questions.explanation: In 'I Have a Dream', African Americans hoped to achieve their civil rights and equality.

questions.question: ________ has taught us to be friendly towards one another.
questions.explanation: Civilization teaches human beings to live together peacefully and be friendly toward one another.
